avis.texte: We have used this sunscreen lotion on multiple beach vacations, and most recently on our cruise. The quality, coverage and protection are great. The lotion glides on smoothly and is not sticky. It has a light fresh scent that did not irritate the members of the family with sensitive skin. This is one of our favorite lotions to use, and we keep repurchasing it. The price point is great as well.

Best smelling sunscreen IMO and the only one that honestly makes it through swimming on my kids. Most sunscreens wear off after water play but this one in particular has great coverage and we find less redness after a full day in the sun and water play on my kiddos. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: A must have for superior sun protection!
avis.texte: Neutrogena Beach Defense SPF 50 is an absolute game-changer when it comes to sun protection. Whether you're relaxing at the beach, swimming, or enjoying an outdoor adventure, this sunscreen provides broad-spectrum protection that effectively shields the skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays. One of its standout features is its lightweight texture, it glides effortlessly onto the skin without feeling greasy or heavy. Unlike some sunscreens that leave a sticky residue, Beach Defense absorbs quickly and smoothly, making it ideal for both face and body application. Another major plus? Water resistance! This formula stays put, even after swimming or sweating, ensuring continuous protection throughout the day. And despite its strong defense against the sun, it feels refreshing and comfortable on the skin, making reapplication a breeze. I used it during a vacation in the Dominican Republic, and me and my family enjoyed it. My 5 years old girl has been protected from the sun all the time. If you're looking for reliable, effective, and easy-to-use sun protection, this sunscreen is an excellent choice. Highly recommended! ☀️👌

I Was looking for a cream sun product because every all products now are spray. I prefer cream because i feel it is easy to apply than spray. Neutrogena is a very nice sun screen. No stains in my clothes and it is waterproof. Recommended 100%

avis.titre: HUGE WHELPS ALL OVER MY BODY
avis.texte: This is HORRIBLE! I just put this on and it made me break out in HUGE WHELPS ALL OVER! I had to jump in the shower and wash everything off immediately. I have never had an allergic reaction from sunscreen! It has COMPLETELY RUINED MY BEACH TRIP! I am just crying and itching. It is seriously torture. I may have to go to the hospital. I’m here now waiting for my boyfriend to bring me Benadryl. If it doesn’t get better, I’ll have to go to the ER. I haven’t even gotten to the beach yet. I am so upset right now. I have always used Neutrogena for everything on my body. So I don’t understand how this happened.
